```{r}
library(readr)

raw = read_csv("total_WIP.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Data Organizing
index = which(raw$time < 0)

df = data.frame(matrix(, nrow = 1500, ncol = 40))
df[1:c(index[1]-1), 1:2] = raw[1:c(index[1]-1),]

for (i in 2:20){
  df[1:c(c(index[i]-1)-c(index[i-1]+1)+1),(2*i-1):(2*i)] = raw[c(index[i-1]+1):c(index[i]-1),1:2]
}

df2 = na.omit(df[,c(13, seq(2, by=2, 20))])

df_welch = as.data.frame(matrix(as.numeric(unlist(df2[, 2:11])), byrow = T, nrow = 1073))

# Compute the averages across 20 replications
df_welch$x_bar = rowMeans(df_welch)

# Choosing an appropriate window size to compute the moving averages
library(itsmr)

w = 150 # the window size

ts = smooth.ma(df_welch$x_bar, w) # moving averages 
plot.ts(ts, xlab = "Row Number")
```
I choose row 500 to be the truncation level, which corresponds to 1017.333 minutes. For simplicity, lets set the warm-up period to be 1000 minutes.
